github.description: GitHub (official remote MCP server): search code, read files, issues and pull requests.

postgres.description: Read-only PostgreSQL access for the data analyst.

brave-search.description: Brave web search, an alternative to the built-in WebSearch.

apify.description: Apify (free plan: monthly credits): ready-made scrapers for Google Maps, websites, LinkedIn, Instagram and more, plus a web browser for agents. Key: console.apify.com → Settings → API & Integrations.

media.description: Built-in: render SVG post cards to PNG (free, local) and generate pictures with Gemini (free tier, needs GEMINI_API_KEY; optional).

social.description: Built-in: post to Instagram, LinkedIn, X (and more) through Postiz. Every post needs your approval. Key: Postiz → Settings → Public API.

clickup.description: Built-in: read ClickUp spaces, sprint folders, lists and tasks (with sprint points); create tasks and comments only after your approval. Token: ClickUp → Settings → Apps → API Token.

google.description: Built-in: Gmail (search, read, drafts), Google Calendar (events, Meet links) and Google Drive (find, read, new Docs) for one connected account. Everything that writes or sends waits for your approval. Set up: docs/21, then Apps → Connect Google.
